title: Positive tensor powers preserve absolute ampleness
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], and k a positive natural number. If M is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], then its kth tensor power is ample.

proof.text: At each point unpack absolute ampleness and keep its affine open, positive exponent n and section s of M^n. Form tensorPowSection of homOfGlobalSection(s), raised to the positive exponent k. The source ClearDenominators theorem exists_tensorPowSectionOne_eq_pow_smul supplies a local free frame E for this tensor power and coefficient a^k when s has coefficient a in a free frame. Its restriction identity identifies this with the global powered section.

Prove that a local free generator gives a bijective scalar map on stalks by representing scalars and vectors as germs. Its span is top, so Submodule.mem_smul_span_singleton identifies maximal-ideal membership of a times the frame with membership of a. A positive power of a is a unit exactly when a is a unit. Hence the powered section has the original nonvanishing locus.

Transport the powered section through tensorPowMulIso, the equality n*k=k*n, and tensorPowMulIso again. Prove preservation of nonvanishing under a module isomorphism using inverse linear maps on stalks and Submodule.smul_top_le_comap_smul_top. The resulting section of (M^k)^n has the same affine locus. Compactness is unchanged.
